name: OpenUI
summary: Open standard for generative UI: a streaming-first language that models write to render live interfaces from your own components.
description: A generative UI framework built on OpenUI Lang, a compact streaming-first language where each line defines one component, so interfaces render while the model is still streaming. The open-source SDK ships React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, email, browser-bundle and CLI entrypoints, headless chat hooks and a default component library, and renders with your own design system (shadcn/ui, Material UI, daisyUI and more). Managed OpenUI Gateway validates and repairs generated output for production.
contains: OpenUI Lang averages 1,362 tokens per screen, up to 67% fewer than JSON formats (project benchmark)
SDK entrypoints: React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, email, browser bundle and CLI
renders charts, forms, cards, tables, dashboards and app screens, not only chat
component libraries for shadcn/ui and Material UI; bring your own design system
integrations: Vercel AI SDK, LangChain/LangGraph, Mastra, Google ADK, FastAPI, CopilotKit, Nuxt, SvelteKit
OpenUI Gateway: validates and repairs output, provider failover, OpenAI-compatible
Gateway pricing from $0 to $49 and $499 per month; Observability in early access
MIT licensed; 10.7k GitHub stars and 3M+ package downloads
